messages:
leo: quick report: node sample app replayed a POST after 429s and created duplicates in staging. looks like SDK ignored Retry-After and retried immediately.

anya: thanks. is this the demo that uses fetch+auto-retry middleware?

leo: yes. middleware retries on network errors but treats 429 as transient. no idempotency key added by sample.

node-ci: failing test: "duplicate create when 429 occurs" on branch fix/retry.

anya: short-term fix: update sample to set `Idempotency-Key` for create endpoints. longer-term: SDKs should default to exponential+full-jitter and honor Retry-After header. add a client option `safeReplay` default false.

leo: i'll open a ticket and add a tiny note in onboarding docs so new users don't copy unsafe retry patterns.

devex-bot: created ticket DEVEX-1034 assigned to @leo and @anya.
